brief.en: Green Leaf Coffee Facebook promotional posts

value.zh: 欢迎来到绿叶咖啡!我们是你的本地咖啡店,每天为社区提供新鲜现磨的咖啡。无论是早晨提神还是下午小憩,我们都在这里等你。
value.en: Welcome to Green Leaf Coffee! We're your local coffee shop, serving the community with freshly brewed coffee every day. Whether it's a morning boost or afternoon break, we're here for you.

value.zh: 本周特别推荐。绿叶咖啡为你准备了精选本地咖啡豆,香醇口感值得品味。来店里试试我们的招牌拿铁和卡布奇诺。
value.en: This week's special. Green Leaf Coffee presents selected local coffee beans with rich flavors worth savoring. Visit us to try our signature lattes and cappuccinos.

brief.zh: 晨光烘焙的 Facebook 推广帖
brief.en: Morning Light Bakery Facebook promotional posts

value.zh: 晨光烘焙欢迎你!我们每天清晨开始制作手工面包,用优质食材和传统工艺为社区带来新鲜美味。从法棍到全麦面包,每一款都用心烘焙。
value.en: Morning Light Bakery welcomes you! We start each morning crafting artisan bread, bringing fresh goodness to the community with quality ingredients and traditional methods. From baguettes to whole wheat, every loaf is baked with care.

value.zh: 本周新品上架。晨光烘焙推出新款手工面包系列,结合传统配方和创新口味。周末来店里品尝我们的羊角包和丹麦酥。
value.en: New arrivals this week. Morning Light Bakery introduces new artisan bread varieties, combining traditional recipes with innovative flavors. Visit this weekend to taste our croissants and Danish pastries.
